question: On the same 50 pinned dataset tasks, how do teacher-only LeWM PushT CEM candidate and elite budgets affect paired task success and synchronized planner solve time when iterations remain fixed at 30?

scope.optional_action_difference: omitted unless already available without changing the frozen evaluation path

protocol.preprocessing: reuse the existing baseline helper: full-dataset StandardScaler for action/proprio/state after NaN-row removal, goal scaler reuse, and pinned ToImage/float32/ImageNet-normalize/Resize(224) transforms
protocol.evaluator: reuse run_dataset_teacher_baseline.evaluate_selected_tasks and the pinned _set_state/_set_goal_state callables; video=None

reference_baseline.engineering_floor: at least 5/50; a continuation gate only
reference_baseline.stage1_rule: Rerun 300/30 first in this job on the exact frozen rows. Require valid finite 50-task outcomes, at least 5 successes, and exact itemwise equality to the reference 25534994 success vector. If any check fails, record the control result and stop before all other arms.

measurement.paired_unit: same dataset row_index, episode_idx, and start_step for every arm
measurement.planner_walltime: time every solver.solve call with torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before and after; sum for full synchronized planner solve walltime and retain each solve duration
measurement.steady_state_timing: report median of all solver.solve calls after the first plus post_first_solve_sample_count; explicitly report second_solve_seconds, which is a one-sample descriptive timing when only two calls occur
measurement.actual_planner_calls: record solver.solve invocation count and CEM candidate-cost evaluation count computed from pinned n_steps and batch_size/environment chunking
measurement.success_outcomes: store the complete ordered 50-item outcome vector and per-task rows for each arm
measurement.primary_comparison: paired success losses versus 300/30 plus synchronized second_solve_seconds ratio, with all per-solve durations and total also reported
measurement.descriptive_budget_screen: at most 5 fewer successes among 50 and at least 20% lower second-solve time; one-call descriptive screen only, not a robust timing estimate or formal noninferiority
measurement.cold_call: do not use full totals alone to claim speed; report full totals and per-solve durations, distinguish first and second calls
measurement.gpu_telemetry: nvidia-smi utilization and memory every 5 seconds appended to job.log

validity: compute node confirmed by PBS_JOBID and PBS_NODEFILE
frozen dataset/checkpoint file sizes and cache links match
all arms use 50 exact frozen rows
each arm returns 50 finite metrics and 50 finite planner outputs
300/30 stage1 success vector exactly matches reference baseline
validity_and_stopping.stop_after_stage1: stop all remaining arms on invalid outputs, success-vector mismatch, or fewer than 5/50 control successes
validity_and_stopping.no_posthoc_extension: no task substitution, reruns, retuning, or extra arms after looking at results
validity_and_stopping.inference_limit: 50 paired tasks do not support a formal noninferiority claim; report descriptive paired outcomes only

compute_node_guards: PBS_NODEFILE is a real file and contains current hostname
resources.login_node_work: control only; no model/data reads or inference
